course_summary:
ISEN 620 | Survey of Optimization | Spring 2026
Instructor: Shixuan Zhang | shixuan.zhang@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 2:20PM-3:35PM | ETB 1013
Grading: Homework Assignments [10%], Midterm Exam [40%], Final Exam [50%] — A: [90%, 100%], B: [80%, 90%), C: [70%, 80%), D: [60%, 70%), F: [0%, 60%)
Topics: K-K-T conditions, Lagrange conditions, simplex methods, duality theory, sensitivity analysis, deterministic linear optimization, unconstrained-nonlinear optimization, constrained-nonlinear optimization, integer optimization solution methods, mixed-integer optimization solution methods, continuous linear optimization methods, nonlinear optimization methods, numerical algorithms, linear optimization modeling, optimization models (linear, nonlinear, continuous, integer, mixed-integer), real-world problems, model characteristics (convex, nonconvex), local solutions, global solutions, linear programming
Tools: Canvas
Prerequisites: MATH 304 or MATH 311
